# SummarizePaper

> SummarizePaper (summarizepaper.com) publishes AI summaries of arXiv research papers, in English and French. Each paper page gives a detailed summary, the key points, a lay summary anyone can understand, a blog-style article, related papers and the BibTeX entry, all generated from the full text of the paper. It is free to read and is run by an astrophysics researcher, Quentin Kral.

Paper pages follow the pattern `https://www.summarizepaper.com/<lang>/arxiv-id/<arXiv ID>/`, where `<lang>` is `en` or `fr`, for example https://www.summarizepaper.com/en/arxiv-id/2302.13303v1/. Every summarized paper is listed in the sitemap. Summaries are produced by OpenAI language models from the HTML or PDF version published by arXiv; the original paper on arxiv.org remains the reference.

## Main pages

- [Home and search](https://www.summarizepaper.com/en/): look up any arXiv paper by title, keywords or arXiv ID
- [Sitemap of summarized papers](https://www.summarizepaper.com/sitemap.xml): every paper and language that has a summary
- [FAQ](https://www.summarizepaper.com/en/faq/): how the summaries are made, limits, Premium, digest, exports, how to cite
- [About](https://www.summarizepaper.com/en/about/): who runs the site and why
- [Chat with papers](https://www.summarizepaper.com/en/chat/): an AI assistant that answers questions from the full text of one or several papers
- [Daily digest](https://www.summarizepaper.com/en/digest/): a free weekday email with new papers in chosen arXiv categories, each with a two-sentence summary

## Optional

- [Premium](https://www.summarizepaper.com/en/premium/): the most capable model and higher daily limits, billed monthly or yearly
- [Privacy policy](https://www.summarizepaper.com/en/privacy/)
- [Source code](https://github.com/summarizepaper/summarizepaper): the site is open source
